chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad al-Nahdī, from ʿAmr ibn ʿUthmān, from a man, from Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, who said:
It is a right upon Allah that He not be disobeyed in a house except that He exposes it to the sun until it purifies it.

key_terms.حَقٌّ: an established due or binding right
key_terms.لِلشَّمْسِ: to the sun, meaning exposed to sunlight
key_terms.يُعْصَى: to be disobeyed through sin and مخالفة

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about disobeying Allah in the home?
ai.summary: This hadith warns against disobedience to Allah within the home and portrays sin as bringing defilement upon a dwelling. It emphasizes divine moral order and the serious ethical consequences of wrongdoing in one’s domestic space.

en.hubeali:
Al Hassan Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad Al Nahdy, from Amro Bin Usman, from a man, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘It is a right upon Allah<sup>azwj</sup> that He<sup>azwj</sup> would not be disobeyed in a house except that He<sup>azwj</sup> Exposes it to the sun until it cleans it (by ruining it)’.
en.sarwar: 18. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Nahdi from ‘Amr ibn ‘Uthman from a man from abu al-Hassan (a.s.) who has said the following: “
It is a responsibility for Allah to expose the house wherein sin is committed, to the sun to cleanse it (subject it to ruination).”
